megumin_intro_front_desk.title: Megumin at Reception
megumin_intro_front_desk_000: Megumin hands a first-visit guide to the woman with both hands, solemnly raising another hand to point down the corridor on the right.
megumin_intro_front_desk_001: “Listen well, lost traveler! Cross the right-hand corridor, take the elevator to the second floor, and follow the blue signs to reach the clinic you seek!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_002: “Oh… second floor, then right, yes? Thank you, little nurse.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_003: Megumin nods, then earnestly points to her name badge.
megumin_intro_front_desk_004: “The directions are exactly right! But I must clarify something: I am a part-time receptionist, not a nurse. If you need nursing assistance, I will contact the medical staff for you!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_005: The woman smiles her thanks and leaves the desk, following Megumin's directions toward the elevator. Only after making sure she is going the right way does Megumin turn to Sakaguchi.
megumin_intro_front_desk_006: “Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi! We met the other day. This time, allow me to introduce myself properly!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_007: “Hello! Are you here to register, visit someone, or learn about our hospital's seven mysteries?”
megumin_intro_front_desk_008: “…Is that third one an official reception service too?”
megumin_intro_front_desk_009: “It has yet to be approved. But I am already compiling an investigation index!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_010: “I am Megumin, the part-time receptionist! Directions around the hospital, general administrative registration, lost and found—leave them all to me!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_011: “Ryuji Sakaguchi. You seem quite experienced at this.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_012: “Heh-heh! I've memorized every department's floor, extension number, and the directions people ask for most.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_013: Megumin opens her register. Public department phone numbers and visitor routes are neatly organized with differently colored tabs.
megumin_intro_front_desk_014: “Of course, drawing blood, giving injections, treating patients, and making medical judgments are not my job. If anyone mistakes this cap for a nursing license, I will promptly correct them!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_015: Aqua Mizuki passes through the lobby corridor and stops when she hears Megumin's solemn introduction.
megumin_intro_front_desk_016: “I recommended you for a reception job, not so you could turn every set of directions into a quest to defeat the Demon King.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_017: “Miss Aqua! Every direction I gave was correct. Not one visitor went the wrong way!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_018: “That's true. Dr. Sakaguchi, she's very capable. She just gets a little dramatic.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_020: Aqua smiles and waves to Megumin before continuing down the corridor.
megumin_intro_front_desk_022: “Dr. Aqua Mizuki! She said I speak clearly and have a good memory, so reception would suit me.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_023: “I see. She has a good eye.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_024: “Of course! Though she occasionally says my explanations are three times longer than the signs…”
megumin_intro_front_desk_026: “I only look at it during lunch. After I finish work at five, I still have night school.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_028: “The evening high school a block from the hospital. My family doesn't have much money, so after junior high I chose this path: work during the day, study at night, and save little by little.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_029: “Are you hoping to go to university?”
megumin_intro_front_desk_030: “Of course! I'm deciding between medicine and nursing. Surgeons working under the operating lights look so impressive, but nurses keeping an entire ward running are amazing too.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_031: “Once I learn a little more, I'm sure I'll work out which path I want to take.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_032.choice0: “You certainly have spirit. I'll leave reception in your hands.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_032.choice1: “Work and night school are a lot to keep up with. Don't wear yourself out.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_033: “You certainly have spirit. I'll leave reception in your hands.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_034: Megumin's red eyes light up, and she bows solemnly to Sakaguchi.
megumin_intro_front_desk_035: “Leave it to me, Dr. Sakaguchi! I will protect the order of Hoshimi Hospital's first floor!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_036: “Work and night school are a lot to keep up with. Don't wear yourself out.”
megumin_intro_front_desk_037: Megumin pauses, then pulls her schoolbag strap farther onto her shoulder.
megumin_intro_front_desk_038: “Thank you for worrying! I'm good at managing my time. It's just that math problems can be more stubborn than a night shift… Wait, I've never worked a night shift!”
megumin_intro_front_desk_039: Megumin puts the worksheet in her bag and turns to the next visitor approaching the desk, returning to her clear, brisk reception voice.
megumin_intro_front_desk_040: “Welcome to Hoshimi Hospital! Which department are you looking for?”
megumin_intro_front_desk_041: Sakaguchi leaves reception. Behind him, her directions are precise and concise.
megumin_r01.title: Maps and Notes (Directions)
megumin_r01_000: [Three differently colored arrows are stuck to the corner of the reception floor plan.]
megumin_r01_002: “My improved directions. Red is surgery, blue is the wards, and yellow—”
megumin_r01_004: “The restroom I've already been asked about five times today. A priority protection target.”
megumin_r02.title: The Trickiest Request (Administration)
megumin_r02_000: “Someone asked today if we could move the bench outside the hospital next to the consulting room.”
megumin_r02_002: “I directed him to the waiting area. It already has six chairs, and they're completely free.”
megumin_r02_003: [She writes in her log: ‘Bench request: resolved.’]
megumin_r03.title: The Queue Machine's Protest (Equipment)
megumin_r03_000: [The queue machine keeps repeating the same number. Megumin mutes it and puts up a small note: ‘Please check the screen.’]
megumin_r03_002: “I've notified maintenance. Until it's repaired, I refuse to let it keep shouting at patient twenty-three.”
megumin_r03_004: “Twenty-three finished their appointment and went home.”
megumin_r04.title: Lost-Property Philosophy (Small Things)
megumin_r04_000: “Today the lost-property box gained an umbrella, a glove, and a note saying ‘Don't lose it again.’”
megumin_r04_001: “Does the note count as lost property too?”
megumin_r04_002: “Of course. If its owner really intends to obey that command, they should come back for it first.”
megumin_r05.title: Real Praise (Warmth)
megumin_r05_000: [Megumin quietly returns an old pen to the holder.]
megumin_r05_001: “An elderly lady just told me she only found her consulting room thanks to me.”
megumin_r05_003: “I know. She was praising my directions, not my meticulously detailed hospital map… But I'm still happy.”
megumin_r06.title: Work and Study (Self-Discipline)
megumin_r06_001: “I only look at it at lunch. When someone is at the counter, my calculating powers are reserved for checking floors and numbers.”
megumin_r06_003: “Of course. If I fail math, I can retake the exam. If a patient goes to the wrong department, I can't make them wait for my retake.”
megumin_r07.title: The Noticeboard Battle (Observation)
megumin_r07_000: [A new notice is crooked. Megumin steps back three paces, studies it, then takes it down and puts it up straight.]
megumin_r07_002: “If a notice can't even stand straight itself, how can we expect visitors to trust it?”
megumin_r08.title: The Weight of a Name (Reception)
megumin_r08_000: “A family member wanted to see ‘that doctor with glasses.’”
megumin_r08_002: “I asked her to confirm the department first. So far today, the people with glasses passing reception include two doctors, an accountant, and my math teacher.”
megumin_r08_004: “To lend me the reference book I forgot to bring. More punctual than a chief physician.”
megumin_r09.title: Zero in the Basement (A Basic Ghost Story)
megumin_r09_000: “I hear there's a room on basement level one that's never been used.”
megumin_r09_002: “Then why do they check the light outside its door every year?”
megumin_r09_003: [She pauses, waiting for Sakaguchi to look surprised.]
megumin_r09_005: “…You really aren't kind to ghost stories.”
megumin_r10.title: The Elevator That Opens Itself (A Basic Ghost Story)
megumin_r10_000: “Last night the elevator came to the first floor and opened its doors all by itself. Nobody was inside.”
megumin_r10_001: “Maybe someone pressed the button, then took the stairs instead.”
megumin_r10_002: “Why do you always give my stories a perfectly reasonable culprit?”
megumin_r11.title: The Red Light in OR Three (An Illusion)
megumin_r11_000: [Megumin sketches a door on a scrap of paper.]
megumin_r11_001: “They say the light in operating room three sometimes stays on late into the night.”
megumin_r11_003: “That's the official explanation my investigation uncovered. Unfortunately, it's very convincing.”
megumin_r12.title: Footsteps at Midnight (Sounds)
megumin_r12_000: “Someone says there's a strange ‘slap, slap, slap’ in the corridor at midnight.”
megumin_r12_002: “I finish at five! How could I? That's exactly why I need reliable witnesses.”
megumin_r13.title: The Missing Whiteboard Pen (Comedy)
megumin_r13_000: [A row of differently colored whiteboard pens sits on the reception desk.]
megumin_r13_001: “I've discovered that the hospital loses one whiteboard pen every day.”
megumin_r13_003: “Most turn up in somebody else's white-coat pocket the next morning. Hospital pens are migratory.”
megumin_r14.title: Rumors of an Old Operating Table (No Answers Yet)
megumin_r14_000: “Some say there's an old operating table in the basement with unspeakable things hidden inside.”
megumin_r14_002: “No. That's why it's a rumor. If I'd seen it myself, it would be… an equipment inspection report.”
megumin_r14_003: [She earnestly writes ‘Evidence: zero’ in her notebook.]
megumin_r15.title: Progress on the Seven Mysteries (Self-Mockery)
megumin_r15_000: “How's your investigation into the seven mysteries?”
megumin_r15_001: “The cleaner explained the first, maintenance explained the second, and the third…”
megumin_r15_003: “The third is working hard to avoid being explained.”
megumin_r16.title: Why Aqua Recommended Her
megumin_r16_000: [Aqua Mizuki passes reception. Megumin immediately stands up straight.]
megumin_r16_002: “Very good. Now could you take that school homework out of the appointment folder?”
megumin_r16_003: [Megumin falls silent for a second, then removes the sheet of formulas.]
megumin_r16_004: “…Zero administrative errors. A slight fluctuation in classification.”
megumin_r17.title: Doctor or Nurse (Aqua)
megumin_r17_000: “Dr. Aqua, how did you decide to study medicine?”
megumin_r17_001: “I liked finding out exactly what was wrong with people's bodies.”
megumin_r17_003: “You could ask Nanase and the others. A successful operation needs more than just my judgment.”
megumin_r17_004: [Megumin writes two words side by side on a blank page in her textbook: ‘Doctor / Nurse.’]
megumin_r18.title: The Weight of a Signature (Narumi Jinguji)
megumin_r18_000: [Narumi Jinguji places a stack of receipt forms on the counter.]
megumin_r18_001: “Have you checked the recipients, times, and page counts?”
megumin_r18_002: “All complete. I've also put them back in date order.”
megumin_r18_004: [After Narumi leaves, Megumin looks at the forms and quietly squares her shoulders a little higher.]
megumin_r19.title: The Clearest Directions (Ren Nanase)
megumin_r19_000: “Miss Nanase, when I say ‘Please go right,’ some people always look left first.”
megumin_r19_001: “Try facing the corridor with them, then point again.”
megumin_r19_003: “So directions have a patient's perspective too!”
megumin_r19_004: “A visitor's perspective. But it's much the same idea.”
megumin_r20.title: A Dangerous Slogan (Manami Iimura)
megumin_r20_000: [Manami Iimura comes to reception for some documents. Megumin produces a homemade card.]
megumin_r20_001: “I thought of a slogan for our pharmacy: ‘Medicine cures all—victory in a single strike!’”
megumin_r20_002: “Take out ‘victory’ first. Medicine isn't for duels.”
megumin_r20_003: “Then, ‘Please take as directed by your pharmacist’?”
megumin_r20_004: “That one can at least go on an actual instruction sheet.”
megumin_r21.title: The Director's Slogan (Asuka Shiromiya)
megumin_r21_000: “Director, I'd like to write a slogan for reception!”
megumin_r21_003: “Very good. But first check that all the floor signs are up to date.”
megumin_r21_004: [Megumin immediately picks up a folder and goes to check.]
megumin_r22.title: An Answer from the Basement (Tae Takemi)
megumin_r22_000: [Tae Takemi signs for a package at reception. Megumin tries hard to sound calm.]
megumin_r22_001: “Dr. Takemi, is it true the basement holds many unknown secrets?”
megumin_r22_004: “Where I left my coffee. Want to come down and help me find it?”
megumin_r22_005: [Megumin considers this seriously for three seconds, then shakes her head.]
megumin_r23.title: The Head Nurse and the Cap (Chizuru Ishigami)
megumin_r23_000: [Head Nurse Ishigami stops at reception, her gaze settling on Megumin's little white cap.]
megumin_r23_001: “Head Nurse, am I wearing it incorrectly?”
megumin_r23_002: “No. But don't let patients think you can perform nursing assessments.”
megumin_r23_003: “Understood. Next time someone asks if I can give injections, I'll call a real nurse over.”
megumin_r23_004: [Ishigami nods and leaves. Only then does Megumin breathe out.]
megumin_r24.title: An Excessively Formal Business Card (Saeko Hikami)
megumin_r24_000: [Saeko Hikami takes an unusually formal business card from her bag and solemnly hands it to Megumin.]
megumin_r24_001: “‘Please contact separately regarding relevant matters’… Is that a job title?”
megumin_r24_002: “It is… a very important professional phrase.”
megumin_r24_003: “Then I'll put it in the ‘Unclassifiable’ drawer beside lost and found.”
megumin_r25.title: Changing Before Five (Departure, Two Outfits)
megumin_r25_000: [Megumin puts her textbooks in her schoolbag. She has already changed into her navy night-school uniform.]
megumin_r25_002: “A math quiz. I want to look well prepared before school lets out.”
megumin_r25_004: “Thanks. I hope my brain can report for duty as punctually as my uniform.”
megumin_r26.title: Savings Plan (Personal Life)
megumin_r26_000: [Megumin crosses out an expense in her notebook with a pencil.]
megumin_r26_002: “Yes. I've saved enough for next month's reference books.”
megumin_r26_004: “Not yet. I still haven't found a way to understand books without buying them.”
megumin_r27.title: A Problem That Won't Explode (Study)
megumin_r27_000: “Doctor, what do you think is the hardest enemy in the world to defeat?”
megumin_r27_002: [Megumin opens a workbook. One problem has been circled five times.]
megumin_r27_003: “Quadratic functions. They don't even make a sound when you defeat them.”
megumin_r28.title: An Undecided Application (A Quiet Ending)
megumin_r28_000: [A guide to university majors pokes out of her schoolbag. The pages for ‘Medicine’ and ‘Nursing’ are both dog-eared.]
megumin_r28_002: “Yes. I want to understand both properly. It's years of study, after all. I can't choose just because it sounds impressive.”
megumin_r28_003: [She smooths the folded corners, puts the book away, and turns to help the next visitor.]
megumin_m01.title: Rescue Statistics for the Lost
megumin_m01_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, today's battle report! As of just now, I have successfully rescued five visitors who lost their way in the first-floor corridor!”
megumin_m01_001: “Aren't there only two ways to go down here—the outpatient corridor and the elevator? How do they get lost?”
megumin_m01_002: “Do not underestimate Hoshimi Hospital's power to distort space! That elderly lady was holding a pharmacy collection slip and nearly charged straight into the director's office!”
megumin_m01_004: “Heh-heh! Protecting the peace of the director's office is an important reception duty too!”
megumin_m02.title: The White Cap's Mistaken Authority
megumin_m02_000: “Phew… Dr. Sakaguchi, I nearly faced a major career crisis just now.”
megumin_m02_002: “No! A woman saw my little white cap and insisted on rolling up her sleeve so I could draw her blood right here. I told her I'm only a part-time receptionist with no nursing license, and she praised me for being ‘so modest at such a young age’!”
megumin_m02_003: “Well, at first glance your reception uniform does look like an old-fashioned nurse's uniform.”
megumin_m02_004: “So I immediately pointed to my ‘Reception / Non-medical Staff’ badge and called a real nurse as quickly as possible. Practicing without a license is a taboo I will never touch!”
megumin_m03.title: The Pace That Commands the Automatic Door
megumin_m03_000: (As Sakaguchi passes through the first-floor lobby, he sees Megumin taking two steps back from the automatic front door, then one step forward.)
megumin_m03_001: “…Megumin, what footwork are you practicing by the entrance?”
megumin_m03_002: “Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi! I'm measuring the outer response boundary of this door's infrared sensor!”
megumin_m03_003: “After three days of rigorous observation, I have determined that approaching diagonally at 1.2 meters per second makes the door slide open precisely half a second before my fingertips touch the glass. Well? Doesn't it make for a grand entrance?”
megumin_m03_004: “Very grand. But another half step outside and all the cold air will come into the lobby.”
megumin_m03_005: “Ugh… a miscalculation! I'll retreat to the reception barrier immediately!”
megumin_m04.title: Deciphering Heavenly Handwriting
megumin_m04_000: (Megumin leans over the reception desk, staring motionlessly through a magnifying glass at an internal logistics memo.)
megumin_m04_002: “Shh—Dr. Sakaguchi, I'm deciphering ancient encrypted inscriptions handed down by our physicians. Look at this line: is it ‘deliver at eight tomorrow morning,’ or ‘eat udon at eight tomorrow morning’?”
megumin_m04_003: “…It's ‘prepare stock at eight tomorrow morning.’ But it is terrible handwriting.”
megumin_m04_004: “I see! By comparison, your handwriting is as crisp as print. Every time I register one of your notices, my eyes feel healed.”
megumin_m05.title: The Fork Between Doctor and Head Nurse
megumin_m05_000: (Two well-thumbed university admissions guides sit in a corner of reception. Megumin rests her chin in her hand, deep in thought.)
megumin_m05_002: “Yes… Think about it! If I study medicine and become a surgeon, I could be like you, Dr. Sakaguchi, calling ‘Scalpel!’ beneath the operating lights!”
megumin_m05_003: “But if I study nursing and become a head nurse, I could be like Head Nurse Ishigami: just stand silently at the end of a corridor and the entire floor falls quiet! Both sound so commanding. How am I supposed to choose?”
megumin_m05_004: “Whichever you choose, failing tonight's math quiz at night school won't help either plan.”
megumin_m05_005: “Aah! Please don't invoke evil words like ‘quadratic functions’ at a time like this!”
megumin_m06.title: The Month-End Half-Price Showdown
megumin_m06_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, don't you sense the tension of an approaching final battle in this evening's air?”
megumin_m06_001: “We don't have a major emergency today. What battle do you mean?”
megumin_m06_002: “The shopping street supermarket's Friday-night battle for half-price pork-cutlet bento stickers, of course! If I sprint there the moment night school's first-period bell rings, I can get a luxurious dinner I normally can't justify for just 240 yen!”
megumin_m06_003: “You make discount shopping sound like storming a fortress… Need me to lend you a little spending money?”
megumin_m06_004: “No need, Doctor! Winning every budget battle with precision, using my own part-time wages—that is the romance of working your way through school!”
megumin_m07.title: The Second Uniform at Five
megumin_m07_000: (Just as the five o'clock chime ends, Megumin emerges punctually from the staff changing-room passage, wearing a navy blazer school uniform and carrying her schoolbag.)
megumin_m07_001: “Changed into your uniform? It fits well. You look ready to go.”
megumin_m07_002: “Heh-heh, thank you! By day, I'm the face of Hoshimi Hospital's reception. After five, I'm Megumin, the honor student about to conquer night school's final exams!”
megumin_m07_003: “I'm heading to the corner for a coffee anyway. I'll walk you to the intersection.”
megumin_m07_004: “Sure! Then I entrust this one-block escort mission to you, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
megumin_m08.title: Late-Night Metal in the Basement (Tae Takemi Branch)
megumin_m08_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, I've uncovered an incredible secret. They say there was a thunderous metallic clattering from basement level one yesterday evening!”
megumin_m08_001: “Yesterday evening? Wasn't that logistics wheeling a stainless-steel instrument trolley to sterile supply for cleaning?”
megumin_m08_002: “…Dr. Sakaguchi, when someone solemnly shares a hospital ghost story with you, you should at least gasp obligingly instead of producing an infuriatingly correct answer in one second!”
megumin_m08_003: “Dr. Sakaguchi, I've uncovered an incredible secret. Yesterday, when I passed the elevator lobby after finishing at five, no one was scheduled on basement level one, yet the elevator indicator stopped at B1 all by itself…”
megumin_m08_004: “Someone in the equipment room forgot to turn the lights off?”
megumin_m08_005: “No! I overheard the night nurses whispering about a laboratory downstairs that ordinary people aren't allowed into. Only strange people with a special interest in ‘surgery without anesthetic’ attract the ghost inside…”
megumin_m09.title: Aqua Mizuki: The Top-Secret Floor Plan
megumin_m09_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, after a week of undercover investigation, I have mapped every hidden passage in Hoshimi Hospital!”
megumin_m09_001: “Don't believe her boasting, Doctor. That sheet she's been studying and marking in red is the fire evacuation plan from the first-floor wall.”
megumin_m09_002: “Miss Aqua! Don't undermine me in front of outsiders! Knowing escape routes is part of reception crisis management!”
megumin_m09_003: “Yes, yes, master of crisis management. Drink this strawberry milk first. It won't stay cold until five.”
megumin_m09_004: “…Hmph. Since it's a supply offering from Miss Aqua, I suppose I'll graciously accept!”
megumin_m10.title: Asuka Shiromiya: The Director's Mysterious Package
megumin_m10_000: (A carefully wrapped flat cardboard box sits beside reception. Megumin guards it gingerly with both hands.)
megumin_m10_001: “Dr. Sakaguchi, half a step back, please! These are ‘top-secret medical supplies’ addressed specifically to the director's office. The box even says something about a ‘rare 1970s antique’!”
megumin_m10_002: (Hurrying down the stairs, eyes shining): “Ah, it's here! Megumin, find me some scissors!”
megumin_m10_003: “Director, another vintage collectible sterile surgical gown you've tracked down?”
megumin_m10_004: “Ahem! This is research into the historical evolution of hospital garment patterns! Megumin, excellent work receiving it. I'll bring you some delicious cookies later!”
megumin_m10_005: “I don't quite understand why an old surgical gown makes the director so excited… But if cookies are the reward, consider the mission accomplished!”
megumin_m11.title: Kaori Miyama: Legend of the Blue Gale
megumin_m11_000: (Kaori Miyama strides through the first-floor lobby in scrubs, emergency chart in hand, her brisk footsteps stirring the air.)
megumin_m11_001: (Lowering her voice and scribbling rapidly): “There she is! Always clad in scrubs, able to dash from the first floor to the OR in thirty seconds—the Emergency Department's Blue Flash!”
megumin_m11_002: (Stopping and looking toward reception with a resigned expression): “…Megumin, I heard that from the corridor. I'm just going to examine an emergency patient with abdominal pain. Don't give me a name from a superhero show.”
megumin_m11_003: “Huh? But it's so cool! You agree, don't you, Dr. Sakaguchi?”
megumin_m11_004: “Dr. Miyama, the ‘Blue Flash,’ your patient will get impatient if you don't go.”
megumin_m12.title: Minato Haruka: The Lost Memory Quest
megumin_m12_000: (Minato Haruka ambles up to reception, plants both hands on the counter, and stares at Megumin for a full five seconds.)
megumin_m12_001: “Good morning, Dr. Haruka! How can I help?”
megumin_m12_002: “Morning, little Megumin. …Can I ask you something?”
megumin_m12_004: “Do you know why I just came down from the second floor to see you?”
megumin_m12_005: “…How could you possibly ask reception that?”
megumin_m12_006: (Opening the reception log with practiced ease): “When you passed at ten, you said you'd collect the spare stethoscope you left in the lounge after your rounds. Here! I've cleaned it and put it aside for you!”
megumin_m12_007: “Wow, saved! I knew coming to reception was the right idea!”
megumin_m13.title: Chizuru Ishigami: The Ghost at Absolute Zero
megumin_m13_000: (One hand on her hip, speaking expansively to Sakaguchi): “If you ask me, the true hidden ruler who holds life and death in her hands here isn't our gentle director. It's the woman whose mere glance freezes the air—”
megumin_m13_001: (Appearing silently half a step behind Megumin): “Such a lively conversation at reception. You seem full of energy today.”
megumin_m13_002: (Stiffening, hands pressed to her skirt seams and bowing ninety degrees within a tenth of a second): “H-hello, Head Nurse Ishigami!! I was telling Dr. Sakaguchi about your rigorous hospital management and deeply admirable leadership!!”
megumin_m13_003: (Giving her a cool glance): “Your cap is crooked. Straighten it before serving visitors.”
megumin_m14.title: Manami Iimura: Pharmacy's Admissions Officer
megumin_m14_000: (Manami Iimura wanders up to reception with two small boxes of cream puffs and slips one to Megumin.)
megumin_m14_001: “Megumin, Aqua says you're still choosing between medicine and nursing at university? Take my advice: choose pharmacy and become a pharmacist!”
megumin_m14_002: (Holding the cream puffs, eyes shining): “Pharmacy? An alchemist who mixes mysterious potions like you, Miss Iimura?!”
megumin_m14_003: “It's not quite as mystical as alchemy, but the important thing is that you don't stand for hours like a surgeon. Pharmacy duty and shift details can wait until you've actually got in.”
megumin_m14_004: “Iimura, don't use cream puffs to sway a high school student's university plans. You've been assisting in the OR quite a lot lately yourself.”
megumin_m14_005: “Oh, that's because a certain heartless lead surgeon keeps conscripting me.”
megumin_m15.title: Moe Honjo: Misplaced Seniority
megumin_m15_000: (Hurrying to reception with a stack of pamphlets and bowing nervously): “Um, e-excuse me, miss! Can I leave these new outpatient guides here?”
megumin_m15_001: (Adjusting her cap with an air of seniority): “Yes, third shelf of the display on the left. Thank you for your hard work, young nurse!”
megumin_m15_002: (Passing by and unable to resist): “Honjo, who are you treating as your senior? Megumin is sixteen—two years younger than you.”
megumin_m15_003: “…What?! Sixteen?! S-sorry! You sounded so commanding, I was sure you were more experienced than me…”
megumin_m15_004: (Cheeks slightly pink, proudly straightening): “Heh-heh! That proves I already possess the full dignity of a mature professional woman!”
megumin_m16.title: Satsuki Orikawa: The Seal of the Black-Rimmed Glasses
megumin_m16_000: (Satsuki Orikawa hurries through the lobby, head lowered over a chart folder. At the sight of Sakaguchi, she nervously adjusts her black-rimmed glasses and rushes upstairs.)
megumin_m16_001: (Narrowing her eyes and whispering to Sakaguchi): “Dr. Sakaguchi, I've seen through Nurse Orikawa's secret.”
megumin_m16_003: “From my extensive reading, those heavy black-rimmed glasses must be a ‘restraint’ sealing away astonishing beauty or tremendous power! Once she removes them, all nearby men will instantly lose their fighting strength!”
megumin_m16_004: “…Actually, your intuition might be rather accurate this time.”
megumin_m17.title: Sayaka Nanjo: Extra Lessons from the School Nurse
megumin_m17_000: (During a quiet afternoon interval, Sayaka Nanjo leans over the reception counter and circles a genetics problem in Megumin's biology reference book with a red pen.)
megumin_m17_001: “Look, separate the dominant and recessive ratios here. Doesn't that make it clear?”
megumin_m17_002: “Wow, it does! Dr. Nanjo, your explanations are ten times easier to understand than our night-school teacher's!”
megumin_m17_003: (Straightening with a smile and looking at the approaching Sakaguchi): “I spent two years in a girls' school infirmary, after all. Sixteen-year-old girls are my specialty. What about you, Dr. Sakaguchi? Want some extra lessons from me too?”
megumin_m17_004: “I'll pass. But Megumin, free one-to-one tuition from a qualified doctor is quite a perk for a part-time job.”
megumin_m17_005: “I'll repay Dr. Nanjo by getting full marks!”
megumin_m18.title: Emiko Mido & Artoria: Two Sovereigns Passing
megumin_m18_000: (Emiko Mido and Artoria Pendragon pass through the lobby one after the other. They merely exchange polite nods, yet an invisible spark seems to flash through the air.)
megumin_m18_001: (Crouching behind reception with half her head peeking out, giving a hushed commentary): “Look, Dr. Sakaguchi! The aloof, icy sword saint Dr. Mido and the golden knight commanding a thousand armies, Dr. Artoria, clash silently in the first-floor lobby once again!”
megumin_m18_002: “…They're just catching the same elevator to a meeting on the second floor.”
megumin_m18_003: “You don't understand! When they both reached for the elevator button, even the doors dared not close! You can chat so easily between those two, Dr. Sakaguchi. To me, you're a monster of the same caliber!”
megumin_m19.title: Ren Nanase & Narumi Jinguji: Five O'Clock Bow and Mock Exams
megumin_m19_000: (At exactly five, Megumin is hurrying out with her schoolbag when Ren Nanase, passing through the corridor, calls her back with a smile.)
megumin_m19_001: “Megumin, wait. Your uniform bow is crooked. Come here; I'll straighten it.”
megumin_m19_002: (Standing obediently as Ren gently smooths the burgundy bow): “Hehe, thanks, Ren! I was rushing to finish copying the last registration form.”
megumin_m19_003: (Passing with a cup of tea, asking casually): “Isn't your night-school mock exam next week? If there are science questions you don't understand, bring them to the lounge during the day sometime.”
megumin_m19_004: (Eyes lighting up, nodding vigorously): “Yes! Thank you, Dr. Narumi, Ren, and Dr. Sakaguchi! I'm off to school!”
megumin_m20.title: Megumi Kariya: Two Megumis, One Savings Alliance
megumin_m20_000: (As Sakaguchi passes reception, he sees Megumin and trainee nurse Megumi Kariya huddled over a supermarket flyer, pointing at it together.)
megumin_m20_001: “What are you two up to? I'm starting to confuse you when I call your names.”
megumin_m20_002: “Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi! We're checking this week's bakery specials on the shopping street. I found that buying sliced bread at five on Wednesday saves eighty yen.”
megumin_m20_003: “Exactly! Kariya shares the character ‘Megumi’ in her name, but in tactical insight into cutting living costs, she is my long-lost ally!”
megumin_m20_004: “A night-school student saving for tuition, and a trainee nurse who researches every supermarket discount… Your ‘savings alliance’ is surprisingly well matched.”
megumin_s01.title: April: New Term, New Work
megumin_s01_000: [A newly changed class schedule is pinned beside Megumin's badge.]
megumin_s01_001: “April is busy. New staff at the hospital, new textbooks at school, and I only have one brain.”
megumin_s01_002: “At least it hasn't scheduled two operations at once.”
megumin_s01_003: “Only because my math teacher hasn't worked out how yet.”
megumin_s02.title: Golden Week: A Different Holiday
megumin_s02_000: “Everyone's asking where people are going for Golden Week.”
megumin_s02_002: “The library. The price of borrowing its books is deeply moving.”
megumin_s03.title: Rainy Season: The Fate of Umbrellas
megumin_s03_000: [The reception umbrella rack is crowded with every color. Megumin secures the newly attached numbered tags one by one.]
megumin_s03_001: “The rainy season is a stress test for lost and found.”
megumin_s03_003: “None yet. Today I've decided to strike first.”
megumin_s04.title: Tanabata: The Wish List (Optional Aqua Appearance)
megumin_s04_000: [Many wish slips hang from a little bamboo branch at reception.]
megumin_s04_001: “I wrote, ‘I hope to get into my ideal university.’”
megumin_s04_003: “But what's this crossed-out one beside it?”
megumin_s04_004: “…Hoping the math teacher forgets to bring the exam papers. I've rejected that first draft.”
megumin_s04_005: “I told you to rewrite it yesterday, didn't I?”
megumin_s05.title: August: Summer Hospital Activities
megumin_s05_000: [Megumin places a paper fan on the reception desk. A hospital mascot sketch is drawn on it.]
megumin_s05_001: “A summer event should have a moving mascot!”
megumin_s05_003: [Megumin silently turns the sign-up sheet halfway around. It says ‘Voluntary.’]
megumin_s05_004: “…I support true heroes volunteering of their own accord.”
megumin_s06.title: September: A Fresh Term
megumin_s06_000: “A new term, a fresh start. I'll prepare for class half an hour every day.”
megumin_s06_002: “Yesterday I said I'd review for half an hour every day. They don't conflict. There just isn't enough time.”
megumin_s07.title: Halloween: Reception's Ghost-Story Service
megumin_s07_000: [A little pumpkin sits beside a handwritten card: ‘Investigating the Seven Mysteries.’]
megumin_s07_001: “This month only, ask for directions and get a free ghost story!”
megumin_s07_002: “Can ordinary directions come with just the directions?”
megumin_s07_003: “Yes. The ghost story is a free gift, and you may decline delivery.”
megumin_s08.title: Hospital Festival: The Most Important Post
megumin_s08_000: [Event maps are piled before Megumin, amid the noise of the departments' stalls.]
megumin_s08_001: “I applied for the most important job at the hospital festival.”
megumin_s08_003: “Chief commander of entrance guidance. Without me, nobody could even find the practice-suturing stall.”
megumin_s08_004: [She hands a map to a lost guest, moving quickly and precisely.]
megumin_s09.title: December: The Reception Christmas Bell (Optional Ren Appearance)
megumin_s09_000: [A red ribbon is tied to the little bell at reception.]
megumin_s09_001: “I was going to use this to give every visitor a Christmas greeting.”
megumin_s09_004: “The third visitor asked if I could stop ringing it for a moment. He'd just woken up.”
megumin_s09_005: [Megumin puts the bell back on the counter, leaving only a silent greeting card.]
megumin_s10.title: January: The Year's First Work
megumin_s10_000: “Happy New Year, Dr. Sakaguchi! I've set three goals: better exam results, more savings, and keeping at least one of the seven mysteries intact.”
megumin_s10_002: “The third is difficult. Your support is especially important.”
megumin_s11.title: February: Courtesy Chocolates (Aqua)
megumin_s11_000: [Megumin hands a small, simply wrapped bag of chocolates to Aqua as she passes.]
megumin_s11_002: “Thank you for introducing me to Hoshimi. I finally had a little room in this month's budget.”
megumin_s11_004: “Not today—I have class! Could we do the weekend?”
megumin_s12.title: March: This Year's Results
megumin_s12_000: [Megumin slips a new grade report into her book.]
megumin_s12_002: “I've improved. Much better than when I first started working days and studying nights.”
megumin_s12_004: “Not yet. But now I at least know some answers are worth taking longer to think about.”
megumin_s12_005: [She puts her books back in her bag and turns to help the next visitor.]
megumin_m21.title: April Blossoms: A Scarlet Challenge in the Lobby
megumin_m21_000: (A spring breeze blows through the first-floor entrance. As the automatic door opens, pink and white cherry petals drift onto the lobby floor.)
megumin_m21_001: (Holding a little broom and dustpan, solemnly picking up a petal): “Look, Dr. Sakaguchi! The cherry trees outside have sent us a challenge for the new school year!”
megumin_m21_002: “Isn't it just the wind blowing petals in? You make it sound like someone came to challenge a dojo.”
megumin_m21_003: “Spring is the starting line for every contest! Your operation count this year and my perfect-attendance award at night school both started ticking the instant that first petal entered the lobby!”
megumin_m22.title: June Rains: The Umbrella Rack and Five O'Clock Escort
megumin_m22_000: (At five in the evening, a fine rainy-season drizzle falls outside. Megumin, changed into her navy school uniform, stands under the hospital eaves, carefully holding her schoolbag against herself.)
megumin_m22_001: (Approaching under a large black umbrella): “Forgot your umbrella at home?”
megumin_m22_002: “Ugh… It was only cloudy when I left this morning! Who knew the rainy-season sky would fight so unfairly? I was about to use my gale step and dash across the block to night school!”
megumin_m22_003: “You can't work if you get soaked and catch a cold. Come on. School is at the next corner; I'll walk you there.”
megumin_m22_004: (Stepping under the umbrella and looking up with a smile): “Hehe! Today this big black umbrella is your ‘absolute rainproof barrier,’ Dr. Sakaguchi! Thank you!”
megumin_m23.title: Summer: The Cooling Barrier and Tanabata Wishes
megumin_m23_000: (A decorative Tanabata bamboo branch stands beside reception in the first-floor lobby, covered in colorful wish slips.)
megumin_m23_001: “The sun outside makes you dizzy. It's cooler down here. Megumin, that red slip at the top is yours, isn't it?”
megumin_m23_002: (Hastily reaching to cover it, cheeks pink): “D-Dr. Sakaguchi, how did you recognize it instantly?!”
megumin_m23_003: “Because you're the only one here who would write ‘Victory at my first-choice university! And another five centimeters in height, please!’ with a calligraphy brush.”
megumin_m23_004: “I'm only sixteen! Another five centimeters is a perfectly reasonable scientific request! Look at Miss Aqua's beside it—she wrote ‘May an endless supply of fine liquor fall from the sky.’ I'm much more serious than she is!”
megumin_m24.title: September Exams: Anatomy Versus World History
megumin_m24_000: (During a lull at reception, Megumin rapidly flips through flashcards, muttering to herself.)
megumin_m24_001: “The Battle of Sekigahara, 1600… No, the appendicular artery branches from the ileocolic artery… Um, Magellan's fleet completed the circumnavigation…”
megumin_m24_002: “Are you studying world history for night school or secretly memorizing our surgical anatomy atlas?”
megumin_m24_003: (Rubbing her brow and looking up miserably): “The nurses in the lounge lent me an introductory nursing and anatomy handbook. I got so engrossed that it crossed channels with the historical dates for next week's midterms!”
megumin_m24_004: “Don't bite off more than you can chew. Pass your high school midterms first. There'll be plenty of time for medical anatomy at university.”
megumin_m25.title: Festival Preparations: Pride in the Traditional Reception Uniform
megumin_m25_000: (Tugging at the pale pink trim of her white dress with both hands, asking Sakaguchi earnestly): “Doctor, I heard someone joked at the festival planning meeting about comparing all the departments' uniforms. Is that true?”
megumin_m25_001: “It was just an idea someone tossed out. Did you take it seriously?”
megumin_m25_002: “Heh-heh! I may not be medical staff, but for sheer elegance, my retro reception uniform with its pink trim and little white cap is definitely a vital part of Hoshimi Hospital's visual fighting strength!”
megumin_m25_003: “Yes, yes. Our first-floor representative's uniform is certainly top tier.”
megumin_m26.title: Halloween: Treats or Directions to the Director
megumin_m26_000: (A small bamboo basket with a pumpkin sticker sits at the corner of reception, filled with colorful throat lozenges.)
megumin_m26_001: (Holding two lemon lozenges out to Sakaguchi): “Halt, Dr. Sakaguchi! During Halloween, to pass safely through this lobby, you must first accept these ‘reception-made cough-suppressing magic stones’!”
megumin_m26_002: “Aren't you supposed to ask me for candy at Halloween? Why are you forcing candy on me?”
megumin_m26_003: “Because asking doctors for candy in a hospital would interrupt their work! Instead, I hand lozenges to doctors and nurses coming out of surgery. Festive and good for their throats—reverse Halloween tactics!”
megumin_m27.title: December: The Red Scarf at Five
megumin_m27_000: (At five on a December evening, it is already dark. Megumin has changed into her navy school uniform, with a warm light-red plaid scarf around her neck and a thermos in her hands.)
megumin_m27_002: (Happily touching the fringe): “Miss Aqua and the nurses at the station bought it together as a Christmas present! They said they didn't want my neck getting cold on the way home from night school.”
megumin_m27_003: “I slipped a box of high-sensitivity mechanical-pencil leads into your pencil case for exam preparation too. Open it when you get to school.”
megumin_m27_004: (Eyes shining like stars, waving vigorously): “Wow! Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi! With all this equipment, I'll conquer every subject in the year-end tests!”
megumin_m28.title: January: An Absolute Prediction of Academic Fortune
megumin_m28_000: “Happy New Year, Dr. Sakaguchi! I look forward to working with you again!”
megumin_m28_001: “Happy New Year, Megumin. You can't stop smiling. Did something good happen over the holidays?”
megumin_m28_002: (Taking a neatly folded shrine fortune from her pocket): “Ta-da! Look! I drew ‘Great Blessing’ on my first shrine visit! It says ‘Academic success, help from benefactors, and peace in the place you protect’!”
megumin_m28_003: “With me, the bearer of great fortune, guarding first-floor reception, every operation at Hoshimi Hospital this year is bound to go smoothly!”
megumin_m29.title: February: Fair Distribution of Courtesy Chocolates
megumin_m29_000: (Megumin opens a pretty paper bag at reception. Inside are over a dozen neatly arranged packets of inexpensive miniature chocolates, tied with red ribbons.)
megumin_m29_001: “Dr. Sakaguchi, perfect timing! Please accept this year's ‘daytime appreciation supplies,’ awarded by part-time receptionist Megumin!”
megumin_m29_002: (Accepting the sweetly wrapped little packet with a grateful smile): “Bought with money saved from your job? You shouldn't have spent so much.”
megumin_m29_003: “Heh-heh, don't worry! I bought the supermarket's best-value family bag and divided it up with ribbons myself. Miss Aqua, Head Nurse Ishigami, and all the doctors and nurses who look after me get some! This is an absolutely fair appreciation rationing system!”
megumin_m30.title: March: A Report Card for the Next School Year
megumin_m30_000: (Holding her newly issued night-school year-end report, Megumin steps lightly up to Sakaguchi.)
megumin_m30_001: “Dr. Sakaguchi! Please review this glorious battle report, worthy of Hoshimi Hospital's chronicles!”
megumin_m30_002: (Taking a look at the report): “Excellent in math, biology, and English… Well done, Megumin. Working during the day, studying at night, and still earning these results is really impressive.”
megumin_m30_003: (Blushing shyly at the direct praise, speaking quietly): “When I see you and everyone working so seriously at the hospital each day, I just can't let myself slack off in night-school class.”
megumin_m30_004: (Looking up again, eyes bright and determined): “University is still some way off. But one day, I'll put on a real white coat or nursing uniform and proudly stand alongside all of you!”
megumin_l01.title: The Barrier Guarding the Front Door
megumin_l01_000: “Welcome to Hoshimi Hospital! …Oh, Dr. Sakaguchi. Once again, I am guarding the order of the first-floor entrance flawlessly. Not even a lost fly has slipped through!”
megumin_l01_001: “Good work. With you guarding the front, the second-floor clinic really is quieter.”
megumin_l02.title: The Aesthetics of a Perfect Stamp
megumin_l02_000: “Phew… Look at this appointment confirmation! The bright red ‘Registered’ stamp sits precisely in the center of the box. Stamping craftsmanship worthy of an artwork!”
megumin_l02_001: “A steady hand. I can trust you with registration.”
megumin_l03.title: Commander of the Switchboard
megumin_l03_000: “In just three minutes, I transferred four outside calls precisely to pharmacy, surgery, gynecology, and the director's office! For a moment, I felt like the hidden commander of the entire hospital communications network!”
megumin_l03_001: “Miss Commander, just make sure you don't put sales calls through to the director.”
megumin_l04.title: The Vanishing Ballpoint Pens
megumin_l04_000: “Strange… Ten minutes ago the black ballpoints were right here in the holder. How is there only one left? Is there an interdimensional rift beneath reception that specifically devours stationery…?”
megumin_l04_001: “Could you have tucked one behind your ear just now?”
megumin_l05.title: Disinfectant and Black Tea
megumin_l05_000: “When I first started here, the disinfectant smelled a little harsh. Now I'm used to it, I actually find it reassuring.”
megumin_l05_001: “Sounds like you're halfway to being a true Hoshimi Hospital regular.”
megumin_l06.title: Reception Volume Control
megumin_l06_000: “I accidentally gave directions a little too loudly, and several heads poked out of the second-floor corridor to look down… Hmm. I really should restrain my presence a little in a hospital.”
megumin_l06_001: “Energy isn't a bad thing. At least we can hear where you are from far away.”
megumin_l07.title: Detecting Chart Thickness
megumin_l07_000: “Your chart envelope is twice as thick as usual today, Dr. Sakaguchi. Is there a hard battle ahead? Please return victorious!”
megumin_l07_001: “Just an ordinary preoperative recheck. Don't make it sound like I'm going to war every time.”
megumin_l08.title: The Post-Lunch Battle Against Sleep
megumin_l08_000: “Ugh… The sunshine between two and three is devious, trying to dissolve my will with its warmth! I will never bow to mere drowsiness!”
megumin_l08_001: “Go wash your face if you're sleepy. No one says reception has to keep its eyes wide open twenty-four hours a day.”
megumin_l09.title: Pamphlet Symmetry
megumin_l09_000: “Health pamphlets arranged from dark to light, left to right. Edge alignment error: less than one millimeter! Just looking at such a tidy display makes me feel wonderful!”
megumin_l09_001: “A couple of patients will leaf through them soon, and you'll have to start over.”
megumin_l10.title: Elevator Etiquette
megumin_l10_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, the elevator just came down from the second floor. Walk over now and you won't have to wait! Heh-heh, even its operating cycle is fully under my command.”
megumin_l11.title: Croquette Budget Philosophy
megumin_l11_000: “If I resist buying a sweet drink from the vending machine today, I can add a freshly fried beef croquette when I go to the shopping street after school on Friday… Yes, that calculation works out beautifully!”
megumin_l11_001: “With budgeting that precise, hospital purchasing could recruit you if they need help.”
megumin_l12.title: Ranking Medical Terms by Coolness
megumin_l12_000: “Dr. Sakaguchi, which sounds more like a finishing move: ‘hemostat’ or ‘needle holder’? I spent a full ten minutes thinking about it during study period last night!”
megumin_l12_001: “Try thinking more about your high school exams during study period.”
megumin_l13.title: Studying by Lamplight After Night School
megumin_l13_000: “After I got home from night school yesterday, I did two extra pages in my biology workbook! My eyes were a little sore this morning, but I'm definitely one step closer to university admission!”
megumin_l13_001: “Study hard, but don't cut away all your sleep while you're still growing.”
megumin_l14.title: Balancing White Coats and Nurse Caps
megumin_l14_000: “Watching doctors on rounds this morning made white coats look so impressive. Then I saw the nurses pushing their care trolleys at noon, looking so capable… Aah, the scales of my university plans are swinging wildly again!”
megumin_l14_001: “No rush. You're only sixteen. There's time to take a good look before choosing.”
megumin_l15.title: Secondhand Reference-Book Treasure
megumin_l15_000: “I found a nearly new chemistry reference book at the used bookstore for a third of the original price! It felt like finding rare equipment in a dungeon treasure chest!”
megumin_l15_001: “You may be the only person who can sound that happy about buying a used reference book.”
megumin_l16.title: Hourly Wage Motivation
megumin_l16_000: “Every hour I spend serving visitors diligently makes my university-tuition piggy bank play a crisp level-up sound! Thinking about that, my legs don't ache no matter how long I stand!”
megumin_l16_001: “Great enthusiasm. But sit down to help people if you're tired. Nobody removed your chair.”
megumin_l17.title: The Punctual Five O'Clock Transformation
megumin_l17_000: “Handover complete! Part-time receptionist Megumin has successfully concluded today's duty. Before you now stands high school student Megumin, ready to march on night school!”
megumin_l17_001: “Take it easy on the way. Don't start sprinting in the corridor.”
megumin_l18.title: The Second Battlefield One Block Away
megumin_l18_000: “Good thing night school is just a block away. Even if I finish at five and buy bread for dinner, I can still reach class before the bell! Well then, Dr. Sakaguchi, I'm off!”
megumin_l19.title: The Weight in the Schoolbag
megumin_l19_000: “Double periods of math and English tonight. My bag feels full of lead bricks… But this little weight will never crush me!”
megumin_l19_001: “Want me to carry it as far as the corner on my way? …All right, that expression tells me you're going to say no.”
megumin_l20.title: See You Next Workday
megumin_l20_000: “Handover all finished! Don't tire yourself out on duty tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi. I'll be back at reception punctually next workday!”
megumin_l20_001: “Yes, see you next workday. Pay attention in class.”
megumin_l21.title: April–May: Spring Wind Versus Pollen
megumin_l21_000: “Spring breezes feel lovely on your face, but for patients with hay fever they're indiscriminate area attacks! I've doubled the tissue boxes at reception and stand ready!”
megumin_l21_001: “Thoughtful. We have had more people coming for allergy medicine lately.”
megumin_l22.title: June Rains: Slippery-Floor Warning
megumin_l22_000: “The rain won't stop. I've put the yellow ‘Caution: Wet Floor’ sign in the most visible spot at the entrance! Any accident plotting a fall in this lobby will be stopped before it happens!”
megumin_l22_001: “Good work. Watch your own footing when you run to school at five.”
megumin_l23.title: July: Salvation by Air Conditioning
megumin_l23_000: “The sun is practically melting the asphalt outside. Compared with that, Hoshimi Hospital's first-floor lobby is a summer sanctuary sheltered by an ice barrier! I don't want to take even half a step outside today…”
megumin_l23_001: “Keep to the shade on your way to night school. It'll still be hot at five in this weather.”
megumin_l24.title: August: Typhoons and Summer Festival Longing
megumin_l24_000: “I hear the nearby shrine has summer festival fireworks this month. If I'm in chemistry class at night school that day, maybe a window seat will let me see half a firework!”
megumin_l24_001: “If the fireworks start, I doubt anyone in your class will be thinking about chemical equations.”
megumin_l25.title: September: Autumn Appetite Crisis
megumin_l25_000: “It's only three in the afternoon. Why is my stomach growling already…? The ‘autumn appetite’ curse must be terribly strong. It definitely isn't because I ate half a bowl less rice at lunch!”
megumin_l25_001: “Aren't there still biscuits from the nurses in the reception drawer? Have a couple to tide you over.”
megumin_l26.title: October–November: Ginkgo Leaves and Sweaters
megumin_l26_000: “The ginkgo leaves on the street from the hospital to night school have all turned yellow. They rustle underfoot in the evening, and I feel like I'm walking through an autumn film set!”
megumin_l26_001: “It gets dark early now, and the evening wind is chilly. Wear another layer on your way to class.”
megumin_l27.title: Early December: Reception's Warm-Air Privilege
megumin_l27_000: “Heh-heh, Dr. Sakaguchi, a winter secret exclusive to reception: stand here and move half a step left, and the warm air from the vent above envelops you perfectly!”
megumin_l27_001: “No wonder you've stayed on that square all day.”
megumin_l28.title: Late December–January: The Lure of Hot Corn Soup
megumin_l28_000: “On a freezing evening like this, the hot corn soup in the corner vending machine seems to summon me with a golden glow… Hmm. If I score well on next week's test, I'm definitely buying a can as a reward!”
megumin_l28_001: “When you get that good score, give yourself a little warm reward.”
megumin_l29.title: February: Late Cold and Exam Preparation
megumin_l29_000: “The calendar says spring is nearly here, but the morning and evening wind still cuts like ice blades. Don't catch a chill coming out of a long operation, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
megumin_l29_001: “Thanks. Wrap your scarf tightly when you head home from night school too.”
megumin_l30.title: March: The Breeze Between School Years
megumin_l30_000: “Without noticing, I've been working at Hoshimi reception for quite a while. At first, memorizing department extensions took forever. Now I'm a seasoned receptionist who can handle things on her own!”
megumin_l30_001: “Yes. The first-floor lobby has been lucky to have you.”
megumin_halloween_original_mage_reveal_0: [Scene: The first-floor reception desk. Megumin is in her usual spot, but today she is wearing her original dark mage costume, never before seen at the hospital. Her large wizard hat is particularly striking. The desk still has a clearly identifiable "Reception Assistant" sign. She is neatly stacking directions slips. When Sakaguchi approaches, she immediately straightens up.]
“...Megumin? What is that outfit you’re wearing today?”
“Heh heh heh! You’ve finally noticed, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
[Megumin sets her folder down securely, holds the brim of her hat with one hand, and strikes an imposing pose.]
“The seal is finally broken! I am Megumin, foremost genius mage of the Crimson Demons!”
“Oh, right. It’s Halloween. I thought the hospital had changed the reception uniform again.”
“That ordinary uniform is merely my everyday disguise! Only today may you witness my true power!”
“...Just so we’re clear, fireworks are forbidden in the hospital.”
“I haven’t even done anything yet!”
“Besides, true Explosion magic is beyond comparison with mere fireworks!”
[She raises her hand high, then suddenly remembers that she is still holding a clinic route map she has just checked.]
“So what exactly are you planning to blow up today?”
“Today’s targets are all the visitors lost on Hoshimi Hospital’s first floor! I shall send them straight to the correct consulting room in a single strike!”
“...Isn’t that just your usual job of giving directions?”
“Please do not call my ultimate technique by such an ordinary name!”
[Aqua Mizuki walks through the lobby carrying routine work documents. She spots Megumin’s hat and cannot help stopping.]
“...You really did dig that outfit out.”
“Aqua! Don’t undermine me while I’m announcing the most powerful magic!”
“I’m not undermining you. Just reminding you: if that brim blocks the register, make sure you don’t copy a visitor’s name incorrectly.”
[Megumin holds her hat brim and looks down at the register again.]
“...Then I shall only break a tiny bit of the seal today.”
“Mm-hm. That’s better. Happy Halloween.”
[Aqua smiles and continues on with her work.]
[The wide brim of Megumin’s hat lightly bumps the document rack at reception. She hastily steadies it.]
“Isn’t your hat getting in the way of your work a little?”
“It is part of a great mage’s dignity! ...However, to ensure accurate directions, I can raise the brim a little for now.”
[She adjusts her hat.]
“It suits you. Happy Halloween, Megumin.”
[Megumin’s solemn expression briefly gives way to undisguised happiness, before she tries hard to look imposing again.]
“Heh heh, naturally! Today, the first-floor reception desk shall be guarded by the most powerful mage!”
[Megumin sits back down at reception and picks up the next registration form. Sakaguchi returns to his daily work. The event ends.]
